description_en: Queries the network RTT and low-RTT user statistics within a specified time range
description_zh: 查询指定时间范围内的网络 RTT 和低 RTT 用户统计
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-network-rtt-report --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-date '2026-09-01 00:00:00' --end-date '2026-09-02 00:00:00' --product-type CloudApp --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryNetworkRttReport

parameters.help_en: The ID of the app instance group, which is used to filter data for a specified app instance group. You can call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID. If you do not specify this parameter, data is not filtered by app instance group
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID，用于筛选指定交付组的数据。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取；不传时不按交付组筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. If you do not specify this parameter, the default value is 200. If the value is greater than 1,500, it is processed as 1,500
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。不传时默认 200；大于 1500 时按 1500 处理
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Explicitly pass a value starting from `1`. If you do not specify this parameter, the service processes the request as the first page, but the response may return `0`
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码。建议从 `1` 开始显式传入；不传时服务按首页处理，但响应可能回显 `0`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business region, which is used to filter report data. You can call the [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 业务地域 ID，用于筛选报表数据。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the statistics. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The statistical interval includes the start time but excludes the end time. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。统计区间包含开始时间、不包含结束时间。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end time of the statistics. Required. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The end time cannot be earlier than `StartDate`. The statistical interval includes the start time but excludes the end time. The time span cannot exceed 60 months. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束时间，必填。格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`，且不能早于 `StartDate`。统计区间包含开始时间、不包含结束时间。时间跨度不能超过 60 个月。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Required.

Valid values:

`CloudApp`: Wuying Cloud App.
`CloudBrowser`: Cloud browser.
`WuyingServer`: Enterprise Edition workstation.
`WuyingWorkstation`: Personal Edition Linggou container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`: Linggou Team Edition container workstation.
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`: Linggou Dedicated Edition container workstation.
`AndroidCloud`: Cloud phone.
`AIAgent`: AgentBay (AI agent)
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。必填。

取值：

`CloudApp`：无影云应用。
`CloudBrowser`：云浏览器。
`WuyingServer`：企业版工作站。
`WuyingWorkstation`：个人版灵构容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationTeam`：灵构团队版容器工作站。
`WuyingWorkstationBusiness`：灵构专属版容器工作站。
`AndroidCloud`：云手机。
`AIAgent`：AgentBay（AI 智能体）
parameters.name: product_type

Code.description_en: The business status code. `200` indicates that the request is processed successfully. Other values indicate that the processing failed
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败

Count.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
Count.description_zh: 满足查询条件的记录总数

Message.description_en: The description of the request processing result. If the request is successful, `success` is usually returned
Message.description_zh: 请求处理结果说明。请求成功时通常返回 `success`

NetworkRttReportDataModel.description_en: The list of network RTT report data
NetworkRttReportDataModel.description_zh: 网络 RTT 报表数据列表

items.description_en: The network RTT report data object
items.description_zh: 网络 RTT 报表数据对象

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the app instance group

LowRttUserCount.description_en: The number of users that meet the low-RTT criteria of the report. Unit: users. The current API operation does not return the specific threshold
LowRttUserCount.description_zh: 符合报表低 RTT 判定条件的用户数。单位：人。当前接口不返回具体判定阈值

LowRttUserRate.description_en: The ratio of low-RTT users to the total number of users involved in the statistics. Valid values: 0 to 1. To obtain the percentage, multiply the value by 100
LowRttUserRate.description_zh: 低 RTT 用户数占参与统计用户总数的比值，取值范围为 0～1；如需百分比请乘以 100

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the business region to which the report data belongs
RegionId.description_zh: 报表数据所属的业务地域 ID

RttAvg.description_en: The average RTT of all users involved in the statistics. Unit: milliseconds
RttAvg.description_zh: 所有参与统计用户的平均 RTT。单位：毫秒

RttMax.description_en: The maximum value among the average RTTs of all users. Unit: milliseconds
RttMax.description_zh: 各用户平均 RTT 中的最大值。单位：毫秒

RttMin.description_en: The minimum value among the average RTTs of all users. Unit: milliseconds
RttMin.description_zh: 各用户平均 RTT 中的最小值。单位：毫秒

StatEndDate.description_en: The end time of the statistical window. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
StatEndDate.description_zh: 统计窗口结束时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释

StatStartDate.description_en: The start time of the statistical window. Format: `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8)
StatStartDate.description_zh: 统计窗口开始时间，格式：`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss`。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）解释

TotalUserCount.description_en: The total number of users involved in the RTT calculation for the current statistical window. Unit: users
TotalUserCount.description_zh: 参与本统计窗口 RTT 计算的用户总数。单位：人

PageNumber.description_en: The page number corresponding to the current response

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page used in the current response
PageSize.description_zh: 本次响应采用的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used to troubleshoot request issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于定位请求问题
